description: Current UI guide navigation/keyboard/history regression. Real supported browser, candidate origin only; no records changed. Existing former seven-label test adapted to real visible mobile Create and menu mappings.

steps.fn: async()=>{document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Open navigation"]').click();await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);document.querySelector('.v-mobile-menu a[href="/business"]').click();for(let i=0;i<120&&location.pathname!=='/business';i++)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,20));if(location.pathname!=='/business')throw Error('Navigation failed');history.back();for(let i=0;i<120&&(location.pathname!=='/customers'||document.querySelector('main h1')?.textContent!=='Customers');i++)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,20));if(location.pathname!=='/customers')throw Error('Back failed');return {back:true,path:location.pathname};}

()=>{const client=document.documentElement.clientWidth,scroll=document.documentElement.scrollWidth;if(scroll>client)throw Error('Page overflow at '+innerWidth);const header=[...document.querySelectorAll('header a,header button,header input')].filter(e=>e.getBoundingClientRect().width>0).map(e=>e.getBoundingClientRect().top);if(header.some((y,i)=>i>0&&y<header[i-1]-10))throw Error('Header reading order mismatch');return {width:innerWidth,client,scroll,readingOrder:true};}
